dialogues.speaker: Yi Xian
dialogues.text: Yi Zhu, I miss Mommy again... I wanna accompany her to see the Xiao Market...

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: Don't cry, Xian... I'll go with you this year, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: Let's go buy some toys, check out the Xiao Lanterns, and watch the fireworks. I'll carry you on my back if you get tired.

dialogues.speaker: Yi Xian
dialogues.text: Yi Zhu... *sobs*

dialogues.speaker: Yi Xian
dialogues.text: Then... will you teach me how to make Xiao Lanterns this year? I'd like to make Mommy one.

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: Of course I can. We made one for her together last year. This year, I'll teach you, and you'll be able to make one yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Yi Xian
dialogues.text: Yep!

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: When Mommy sees your Xiao Lantern, her spirit will return, together with all those other heroes. Then, we'll welcome her back with big smiles on our faces!

dialogues.speaker: Yi Xian
dialogues.text: Yeah!

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: Hi... Are you looking for me?

response.speaker: Yi Zhu
response.text: I'm Yi Zhu. I suppose you might've seen my little sister, Yi Xian?

response.speaker: Yi Zhu
response.text: I promised her that we'd spend Lantern Rite together and that I'd teach her how to make a Xiao Lantern for our mother.

response.speaker: Yi Zhu
response.text: I was preparing some materials, but I didn't expect Miss Changshun to specially give us some...

response.speaker: Yi Zhu
response.text: So I've made her one as well. I hope she likes it.

response.speaker: Yi Zhu
response.text: Everyone's been taking good care of my sister and I lately. I'm really grateful.

response.speaker: Yi Zhu
response.text: Goodbye... May the flames of wisdom spread to all, and never be extinguished.

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: Come on Yi Xian, there's a good girl. It's home time...

dialogues.speaker: Yi Xian
dialogues.text: I'm not going home! I'm going to look for Mommy!

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: But Mommy isn't coming home...

dialogues.speaker: Yi Xian
dialogues.text: *sobs* Why won't Mommy come home... Does Mommy not love us anymore?

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: Hey, don't say such silly things...

dialogues.speaker: Yi Xian
dialogues.text: But, but... I know I saw the lady with black clothes bring Mommy here... *sobs*

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: Yi Xian, what happened was... Mommy is one of the stars in the sky now.

dialogues.speaker: Yi Xian
dialogues.text: You mean Mommy isn't sleeping anymore? ...You're lying, I don't believe you!

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: I'm telling the truth, Yi Xian... Listen, how about we wait till nighttime and I take you up onto the roof? When you see the starlight, you will feel Mommy's loving eyes looking down...

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: Hi... Are you looking for me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: I'm Yi Zhu. You probably know my little sister, Yi Xian?

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: With the house so empty these days, I'm worried Yi Xian'll get lonely. So I thought I'd buy her a new toy, see if it takes her mind off things.

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: Changshun was so understanding, she said I could pick one toy to take back home for free. Everyone's been so good to me and my sister... *sniff*

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: *sniff* ...No, I can't cry...I can't let Yi Xian see me unhappy.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rex Lapis' death...

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: Shh, please don't. Sorry, it's just... Please don't say the 'd' word again. Especially not in front of my sister.

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: I don't care much for the news. Right now, all I care about is seeing my sister smile again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: Bye.

dialogues.speaker: Yi Xian
dialogues.text: ...Mommy always used to take us to Xiao Market...

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: Yeah! Mommy would buy toys for us, take us to see the Xiao Lanterns... And she'd carry you when you got tired...

dialogues.speaker: Yi Xian
dialogues.text: ...Yi Zhu, I miss Mommy.

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: Yi Xian... Don't cry, let's make a Xiao Lantern for Mommy, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Yi Xian
dialogues.text: Huh? But I thought Xiao Lanterns were to remember the heroes who look after us...

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: You're right. Well, our mommy was a hero and she looked after us, didn't she?

dialogues.speaker: Yi Zhu
dialogues.text: So come on, wipe your tears away — let's welcome back Mommy's spirit and all the other heroes with big smiles on our faces!

dialogues.speaker: Yi Xian
dialogues.text: Alright!
